Root holds the trees the index covers. Every directory directly under a
root is a project, a repo or not (hidden directories and build output
aside); a git worktree is skipped, since it is its main repo's. A project
name is its directory's name and must be unique: a clash is skipped and
said, and agent index project add DIR --name OTHER adds it under another
name.

Usage:
  agent index root [flags]
  agent index root [command]

Examples:
  agent index root add ~/dev
  agent index root list
  agent index root remove ~/dev

Available Commands:
  add         Add a tree: every directory directly under it becomes a project
  remove      Remove a root and the projects found under it
  list        List the roots and their projects

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for root

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent index root [command] --help" for more information about a command.
